title: Gca Bay Area Ras Garba - Oct 9th By Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team - Sharda Musical Group
description: Immerse Yourself in Cultural Vibrancy at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba Event

long_description:
Immerse Yourself in Cultural Vibrancy at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba Event
Get ready for a night filled with rhythm, color, and tradition at the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba event on the 9th of October, 2026. Organized by the Gujarati Cultural Association of Bay Area (Events), this event is a beautiful representation of Gujarati and Multilingual culture. The Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team along with the Sharda Musical Group will bring to you an unforgettable Navratri/Dandiya experience. Join us and make every beat count!
Experience the Magic with Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team and Sharda Musical Group
Our event features the melodious Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team in collaboration with the Sharda Musical Group. This is a unique blend of traditional Gujarati music with a modern touch. The energy, the rhythm, and the authenticity that these artists bring to the stage are sure to captivate you. Their performances are not just about music, they're about creating an atmosphere where everyone can feel the vibrancy of the culture and the joy of celebration.
Discover the Beauty of Washington High School
The event will take place at the Washington High School, located at 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA, United States. This venue is known for its safety, accessibility, and close proximity to a variety of attractions. Plenty of parking space is available for attendees. After the event, why not explore the local area? There are several Indian restaurants nearby where you can indulge in delicious, authentic Indian cuisine.
Get Your Tickets Now: Make the Night Yours!
Join the GCA Bay Area Ras Garba and be a part of this cultural extravaganza. Tickets are available at $300.00 for General Admission. If you're planning to attend with a group of 8 or more, you can take advantage of our Group Offer at just $23.00 per person. Don’t miss this opportunity to soak in the spirit of Navratri/Dandiya with us.
